sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

As players progress through the levels, the balls become faster and more challenging to dodge. The game also features obstacles such as spikes, pits, and moving platforms that can help or hinder the player's progress. The player's goal is to collect as much money as possible while avoiding the enemy balls and obstacles. The money collected can be used to purchase new skins, which not only enhance the game's visuals but also provide a boost to the player's score.

One of the most interesting aspects of Ball Game is its use of gravity. The player can move up and down the screen, and the balls will follow them accordingly.
